svg.aria-label: Onyx hungry: 32 poses, 5 seconds each, repeating every 160 seconds
svg.title: Onyx — Hungry
svg.desc: Transparent SVG flipbook with 32 individually separated original poses. Each pose displays for 5 seconds. The full sequence is fully interleaved from the target mood and donor moods, and repeats every 160 seconds. Embedded PNG frames preserve all original image detail and alpha.
